New Fields and Interactive Summary Features

features.name: 50% Faster Summary Generation
features.description: The summary generation process is 50% faster than the previous release, allowing users to get insights more quickly.

features.name: Interactive Summary with Field Highlighting
features.description: Summaries are interactive - users can click on fields or interactions to see highlighting and open related pages where insights were obtained.

features.name: Show More Insights
features.description: Users can click show more to generate additional insights beyond those in the initial summary, with the ability to continue conversation with copilot.

features.name: Copy and Share Summary
features.description: Users can copy summaries and share with co-workers via teams or other media, with a formatted summary that is easily sharable.

features.name: Filter Awareness in Summaries
features.description: Summaries now consider filters propagated from list view to card view, providing context-aware insights based on applied filters.

features.name: Multi-Language Support for Summaries
features.description: Summarize with copilot now supports 20 more languages beyond English, making it available in all languages across all regions and localizations.

features.name: Developer Configuration for Summarization
features.description: Developers can now configure via AL whether summarization should be enabled on a certain page, and can impact how summaries work based on custom fields and pages.
caveats: developers do not have direct access to influencing the summary

features.name: Enhanced Fields for Richer Insights
features.description: New fields have been introduced on popular pages like customer card to provide copilot with more data for generating enriched insights.
